title: The Voice of the Silence
author: H. P. Blavatsky
description: A compact Theosophical work presenting spiritual instruction through poetic and contemplative language. Blavatsky explores compassion, discipline and the responsibilities of the spiritual path within her interpretation of Eastern religious themes.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/blavatsky__the_voice_of_the_silence_1889).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
